arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ اقتَرَبَتِ السّاعَةُ وَانشَقَّ القَمَرُ
transliteration: Iqtarabati alssaAAatu wainshaqqa alqamaru
translation: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain

arabic: وَإِن يَرَوا ءايَةً يُعرِضوا وَيَقولوا سِحرٌ مُستَمِرٌّ
transliteration: Wain yaraw ayatan yuAAridoo wayaqooloo sihrun mustamirrun
translation: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion

arabic: وَكَذَّبوا وَاتَّبَعوا أَهواءَهُم وَكُلُّ أَمرٍ مُستَقِرٌّ
transliteration: Wakaththaboo waittabaAAoo ahwaahum wakullu amrin mustaqirrun
translation: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision

arabic: وَلَقَد جاءَهُم مِنَ الأَنباءِ ما فيهِ مُزدَجَرٌ
transliteration: Walaqad jaahum mina alanbai ma feehi muzdajarun
translation: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter

arabic: حِكمَةٌ بٰلِغَةٌ فَما تُغنِ النُّذُرُ
transliteration: Hikmatun balighatun fama tughnee alnnuthuru
translation: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not

arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنهُم يَومَ يَدعُ الدّاعِ إِلىٰ شَيءٍ نُكُرٍ
transliteration: Fatawalla AAanhum yawma yadAAu alddaAAi ila shayin nukurin
translation: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing

arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبصٰرُهُم يَخرُجونَ مِنَ الأَجداثِ كَأَنَّهُم جَرادٌ مُنتَشِرٌ
transliteration: KhushshaAAan absaruhum yakhrujoona mina alajdathi kaannahum jaradun muntashirun
translation: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad

arabic: مُهطِعينَ إِلَى الدّاعِ يَقولُ الكٰفِرونَ هٰذا يَومٌ عَسِرٌ
transliteration: MuhtiAAeena ila alddaAAi yaqoolu alkafiroona hatha yawmun AAasirun
translation: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day

arabic: كَذَّبَت قَبلَهُم قَومُ نوحٍ فَكَذَّبوا عَبدَنا وَقالوا مَجنونٌ وَازدُجِرَ
transliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakaththaboo AAabdana waqaloo majnoonun waizdujira
translation: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed

arabic: فَدَعا رَبَّهُ أَنّى مَغلوبٌ فَانتَصِر
transliteration: FadaAAa rabbahu annee maghloobun faintasir
translation: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help

arabic: فَفَتَحنا أَبوٰبَ السَّماءِ بِماءٍ مُنهَمِرٍ
transliteration: Fafatahna abwaba alssamai bimain munhamirin
translation: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water

arabic: وَفَجَّرنَا الأَرضَ عُيونًا فَالتَقَى الماءُ عَلىٰ أَمرٍ قَد قُدِرَ
transliteration: Wafajjarna alarda AAuyoonan failtaqa almao AAala amrin qad qudira
translation: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose

arabic: وَحَمَلنٰهُ عَلىٰ ذاتِ أَلوٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
transliteration: Wahamalnahu AAala thati alwahin wadusurin
translation: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails

arabic: تَجرى بِأَعيُنِنا جَزاءً لِمَن كانَ كُفِرَ
transliteration: Tajree biaAAyunina jazaan liman kana kufira
translation: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected

arabic: وَلَقَد تَرَكنٰها ءايَةً فَهَل مِن مُدَّكِرٍ
transliteration: Walaqad taraknaha ayatan fahal min muddakirin
translation: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth

arabic: فَكَيفَ كانَ عَذابى وَنُذُرِ
transliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
translation: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

arabic: وَلَقَد يَسَّرنَا القُرءانَ لِلذِّكرِ فَهَل مِن مُدَّكِرٍ
transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

arabic: كَذَّبَت عادٌ فَكَيفَ كانَ عَذابى وَنُذُرِ
transliteration: Kaththabat AAadun fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
translation: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

arabic: إِنّا أَرسَلنا عَلَيهِم ريحًا صَرصَرًا فى يَومِ نَحسٍ مُستَمِرٍّ
transliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirrin
translation: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity

arabic: تَنزِعُ النّاسَ كَأَنَّهُم أَعجازُ نَخلٍ مُنقَعِرٍ
transliteration: TanziAAu alnnasa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin munqaAAirin
translation: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees

arabic: فَكَيفَ كانَ عَذابى وَنُذُرِ
transliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
translation: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

arabic: وَلَقَد يَسَّرنَا القُرءانَ لِلذِّكرِ فَهَل مِن مُدَّكِرٍ
transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

arabic: كَذَّبَت ثَمودُ بِالنُّذُرِ
transliteration: Kaththabat thamoodu bialnnuthuri
translation: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings

arabic: فَقالوا أَبَشَرًا مِنّا وٰحِدًا نَتَّبِعُهُ إِنّا إِذًا لَفى ضَلٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
transliteration: Faqaloo abasharan minna wahidan nattabiAAuhu inna ithan lafee dalalin wasuAAurin
translation: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness

arabic: أَءُلقِىَ الذِّكرُ عَلَيهِ مِن بَينِنا بَل هُوَ كَذّابٌ أَشِرٌ
transliteration: Aolqiya alththikru AAalayhi min baynina bal huwa kaththabun ashirun
translation: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar

arabic: سَيَعلَمونَ غَدًا مَنِ الكَذّابُ الأَشِرُ
transliteration: SayaAAlamoona ghadan mani alkaththabu alashiru
translation: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar

arabic: إِنّا مُرسِلُوا النّاقَةِ فِتنَةً لَهُم فَارتَقِبهُم وَاصطَبِر
transliteration: Inna mursiloo alnnaqati fitnatan lahum fairtaqibhum waistabir
translation: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience

arabic: وَنَبِّئهُم أَنَّ الماءَ قِسمَةٌ بَينَهُم كُلُّ شِربٍ مُحتَضَرٌ
transliteration: Wanabbihum anna almaa qismatun baynahum kullu shirbin muhtadarun
translation: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed

arabic: فَنادَوا صاحِبَهُم فَتَعاطىٰ فَعَقَرَ
transliteration: Fanadaw sahibahum fataAAata faAAaqara
translation: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her)

arabic: فَكَيفَ كانَ عَذابى وَنُذُرِ
transliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
translation: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

arabic: إِنّا أَرسَلنا عَلَيهِم صَيحَةً وٰحِدَةً فَكانوا كَهَشيمِ المُحتَظِرِ
transliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim sayhatan wahidatan fakanoo kahasheemi almuhtathiri
translation: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold

arabic: وَلَقَد يَسَّرنَا القُرءانَ لِلذِّكرِ فَهَل مِن مُدَّكِرٍ
transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

arabic: كَذَّبَت قَومُ لوطٍ بِالنُّذُرِ
transliteration: Kaththabat qawmu lootin bialnnuthuri
translation: The folk of Lot rejected warnings

arabic: إِنّا أَرسَلنا عَلَيهِم حاصِبًا إِلّا ءالَ لوطٍ نَجَّينٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
transliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim hasiban illa ala lootin najjaynahum bisaharin
translation: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night

arabic: نِعمَةً مِن عِندِنا كَذٰلِكَ نَجزى مَن شَكَرَ
transliteration: NiAAmatan min AAindina kathalika najzee man shakara
translation: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks

arabic: وَلَقَد أَنذَرَهُم بَطشَتَنا فَتَمارَوا بِالنُّذُرِ
transliteration: Walaqad antharahum batshatana fatamaraw bialnnuthuri
translation: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings

arabic: وَلَقَد رٰوَدوهُ عَن ضَيفِهِ فَطَمَسنا أَعيُنَهُم فَذوقوا عَذابى وَنُذُرِ
transliteration: Walaqad rawadoohu AAan dayfihi fatamasna aAAyunahum fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri
translation: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings

arabic: وَلَقَد صَبَّحَهُم بُكرَةً عَذابٌ مُستَقِرٌّ
transliteration: Walaqad sabbahahum bukratan AAathabun mustaqirrun
translation: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning

arabic: فَذوقوا عَذابى وَنُذُرِ
transliteration: Fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri
translation: Now taste My punishment after My warnings

arabic: وَلَقَد يَسَّرنَا القُرءانَ لِلذِّكرِ فَهَل مِن مُدَّكِرٍ
transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

arabic: وَلَقَد جاءَ ءالَ فِرعَونَ النُّذُرُ
transliteration: Walaqad jaa ala firAAawna alnnuthuru
translation: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh

arabic: كَذَّبوا بِـٔايٰتِنا كُلِّها فَأَخَذنٰهُم أَخذَ عَزيزٍ مُقتَدِرٍ
transliteration: Kaththaboo biayatina kulliha faakhathnahum akhtha AAazeezin muqtadirin
translation: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful

arabic: أَكُفّارُكُم خَيرٌ مِن أُولٰئِكُم أَم لَكُم بَراءَةٌ فِى الزُّبُرِ
transliteration: Akuffarukum khayrun min olaikum am lakum baraatun fee alzzuburi
translation: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures

arabic: أَم يَقولونَ نَحنُ جَميعٌ مُنتَصِرٌ
transliteration: Am yaqooloona nahnu jameeAAun muntasirun
translation: Or say they: We are a host victorious

arabic: سَيُهزَمُ الجَمعُ وَيُوَلّونَ الدُّبُرَ
transliteration: Sayuhzamu aljamAAu wayuwalloona alddubura
translation: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee

arabic: بَلِ السّاعَةُ مَوعِدُهُم وَالسّاعَةُ أَدهىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
transliteration: Bali alssaAAatu mawAAiduhum waalssaAAatu adha waamarru
translation: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure)

arabic: إِنَّ المُجرِمينَ فى ضَلٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
transliteration: Inna almujrimeena fee dalalin wasuAAurin
translation: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness

arabic: يَومَ يُسحَبونَ فِى النّارِ عَلىٰ وُجوهِهِم ذوقوا مَسَّ سَقَرَ
transliteration: Yawma yushaboona fee alnnari AAala wujoohihim thooqoo massa saqara
translation: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell

arabic: إِنّا كُلَّ شَيءٍ خَلَقنٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
transliteration: Inna kulla shayin khalaqnahu biqadarin
translation: Lo! We have created every thing by measure

arabic: وَما أَمرُنا إِلّا وٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمحٍ بِالبَصَرِ
transliteration: Wama amruna illa wahidatun kalamhin bialbasari
translation: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye

arabic: وَلَقَد أَهلَكنا أَشياعَكُم فَهَل مِن مُدَّكِرٍ
transliteration: Walaqad ahlakna ashyaAAakum fahal min muddakirin
translation: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth

arabic: وَكُلُّ شَيءٍ فَعَلوهُ فِى الزُّبُرِ
transliteration: Wakullu shayin faAAaloohu fee alzzuburi
translation: And every thing they did is in the scriptures

arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغيرٍ وَكَبيرٍ مُستَطَرٌ
transliteration: Wakullu sagheerin wakabeerin mustatarun
translation: And every small and great thing is recorded

arabic: إِنَّ المُتَّقينَ فى جَنّٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaharin
translation: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers

arabic: فى مَقعَدِ صِدقٍ عِندَ مَليكٍ مُقتَدِرٍ
transliteration: Fee maqAAadi sidqin AAinda maleekin muqtadirin
translation: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King
